summary: Added aria-label to theme-option buttons to improve accessibility.
reasoning: The finding highlights that the theme-option buttons lack visible text and accessible names, which can cause issues for users who rely on screen readers. Adding an aria-label attribute provides a text alternative for these buttons, enhancing accessibility.

hunks.newText: <button aria-label={themeMode === option ? 'Switch to ' + option : 'Switch to ' + (option === 'system' ? 'System theme' : option === 'light' ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode')} onClick={() => setThemeMode(option)} aria-pressed={themeMode === option} title={option === 'system' ? 'System theme' : option === 'light' ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode'} type="button" className={`theme-option ${themeMode === option ? 'active' : ''}`}>
